notes.title: F.I.S.H. Update 1.1 - 2 New Levels!
notes.content:
Update 1.1 Includes:

- A new "Extra Levels" level select that is unlocked after scoring a 15/30 or higher on Level 7
- 2 new levels in the Extra Levels select
- Restart button
- Updated disclaimer screen
- Option to turn off advanced visual effects to improve performance
- John

Thank you to everyone who has purchased F.I.S.H. so far! I have more levels planned for the future, so stay tuned...

notes.title: Version 1.03 Patch Notes
notes.content:
- Fixed an incorrectly placed input on Level 3
- *Fixed getting a 30/30 on Level 15 not reflecting in achievements or in the game (*I haven't gotten a 30/30 on Level 15 yet but the code should work for anyone who gets a 30/30 after this update goes live)
